title: Galbraith Road station entrance and marked parking in 2025
alt: The red Cincinnati Bus Station building has glass entrance doors, bollards and benches; blue wheelchair symbols and yellow diagonal markings are painted on parking surfaces beside a chain-link fence and yellow curb.
caption: Znns photographed the station at 398 East Galbraith Road on August 15, 2025. The full frame shows the front doors, marked parking spaces, diagonal painted areas, benches, bollards, curb and fence. Faithfully resized and converted to WebP without cropping or changing the scene.
author: Znns
limitations: Historical exterior view only. Markings do not establish space dimensions or current availability. Threshold height, door force, powered opening, slopes, toilets, interior circulation and the full route to the operator’s Waldman Drive boarding location are not established. The fence, curb and bollards remain visible; no barrier has been altered.
